notes: Target few-shot coverage is 3 of 4 target databases (stats, ergastf1, genome); imdb is zero-shot only because its independent K>0 support set is missing, so no K>0 imdb cell exists; the imdb test rows were never used as support.
Every target number is a fixed-evaluation output: there was no target-side hyper-parameter selection and no target-side strategy, step or checkpoint selection.
The three paired continuation streams (42/43/44) share one official PRICE pretraining initialization, so this target result is not replicated across independent pretraining runs.
P is a single shared pretraining model; its five support draws are repeated evaluations of that one model, not independent pretrained models.
The zero-shot headline ratios are geometric means over the four target databases; the K20 headline ratios use the paired mean-then-log form over the three few-shot databases only.
